IRS990.MissionDesc: WE ARE A MEMBER-OWNED, NOT-FOR-PROFIT FINANCIAL COOPERATIVE; WE EXIST TO SERVE - TO ENRICH LIVES AND BUILD BETTER FUTURES.
IRS990.Desc: MEMBERSHIP IN BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION ("BLUPEAK") PROVIDES ACCESS TO A ROBUST ARRAY OF QUALITY FINANCIAL SERVICES AND PRODUCTS INCLUDING CHECKING AND SAVINGS ACCOUNTS. UNLIKE BANKS, WHICH RETURN THEIR PROFITS TO SHAREHOLDERS, BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION RETURNS ITS PROFITS TO MEMBERS IN THE FORM OF HIGHER RATES ON DEPOSITS AND A HOST OF FREE AND LOW-COST SERVICES. AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, MEMBERS HELD 70,939 DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS TOTALING OVER $1,119 MILLION. THESE ACCOUNTS INCLUDED FREE CHECKING, LOW-BALANCE SAVINGS, IRA'S, HIGH-YIELD SAVINGS, MONEY MARKET AND TERM INVESTMENT ACCOUNTS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: AS A MEMBER-OWNED, NOT-FOR-PROFIT COOPERATIVE, BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION ("BLUPEAK") IS DEDICATED TO PROVIDING THE FINANCIAL PRODUCTS AND SERVICES MEMBERS NEED AT EVERY STAGE OF LIFE. WHETHER IT'S BUYING A FIRST CAR, FINANCING A NEW HOME, OR SEEKING A HIGHER EDUCATION, BLUPEAK OFFERS MEMBERS LOW-COST HOME, VEHICLE, AND PERSONAL LOANS, AS WELL AS FREE FINANCIAL SEMINARS TO ASSIST THEM IN MAKING SOUND FINANCIAL CHOICES. AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, BLUPEAK MEMBERS HELD 15,131 MORTGAGE, HOME EQUITY, VEHICLE, AND VARIOUS OTHER PERSONAL LOANS TOTALING OVER $825 MILLION.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: SINCE 1936, BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION ("BLUPEAK") HAS BEEN HELPING PEOPLE ACHIEVE THEIR MOST IMPORTANT FINANCIAL GOALS. AS ONE OF CALIFORNIA'S LARGEST CREDIT UNIONS, BLUPEAK OFFERS FULL-SERVICE BANKING INCLUDING FREE AND LOW-COST E-SERVICES. MEMBERS CAN MANAGE THEIR PERSONAL FINANCES ANYTIME, ANYWHERE WITH TELEPHONE, ONLINE AND WIRELESS INTERNET BANKING. AS AN ADDITIONAL CONVENIENCE, BLUPEAK OFFERS BILLPAY SERVICES TO MEMBERS WITH QUALIFYING CHECKING ACCOUNTS AT NO COST. EACH MONTH, APPROXIMATELY 32,000 MEMBERS UTILIZE THE E-SERVICES AVAILABLE 24 HOURS PER DAY. IN ADDITION, BLUPEAK HAS PARTNERED WITH OTHER CREDIT UNIONS TO FORM THE CO-OP ATM NETWORK. THIS NETWORK PROVIDES MEMBERS ACCESS TO APPROXIMATELY 30,000 NO-FEE ATM'S THROUGHOUT THE UNITED STATES, INCLUDING LOCATIONS AT POPULAR RETAILERS.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: ADDITIONAL BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION MEMBERSHIP BENEFITS INCLUDE: 1) PROFESSIONAL BROKERAGE AND INVESTMENT SERVICES, 2) MONEY-SAVING AUTO, HOME, HEALTH AND LIFE INSURANCE PROGRAMS, 3) FREE FINANCIAL EDUCATION TOOLS, AND 4) MERCHANT AND RECREATION DISCOUNTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION'S (BLUPEAK) POLITICAL ACTIVITIES ARE PRIMARILY CENTERED AROUND LEGISLATIVE BILLS OF SPECIFIC INTEREST TO BLUPEAK AND/OR THE CREDIT UNION INDUSTRY. BLUPEAK PARTICIPATES WITH THE CALIFORNIA CREDIT UNION LEAGUE AND THE CREDIT UNION NATIONAL ASSOCIATION (CUNA) BY SENDING LETTERS OF SUPPORT OR OPPOSITION TO PROPOSED LEGISLATION.

BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION (BLUPEAK) MAINTAINS ESCROW ACCOUNTS FOR MORTGAGE LOANS HELD BY MEMBERS. BLUPEAK ALSO HOLDS CUSTODIAL ACCOUNTS TO FACILITATE THE SERVICING OF LOANS SOLD TO ENTITIES SUCH AS FANNIE MAE. AT 12/31/2024 ESCROW BALANCES TOTALED $1,244,863, AND THE VALUE OF ASSETS FOR WHICH THE CREDIT UNION SERVED AS CUSTODIAN WAS $113,166. THE ESCROW BALANCES ARE USED TO PAY FOR REAL ESTATE TAXES AND HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE ON BEHALF OF MEMBERS.

BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION (BLUPEAK) IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES, EXCEPT FOR TAXES ON UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME. BLUPEAK IS A STATE-CHARTERED CREDIT UNION AS DESCRIBED IN INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) SECTION 501(C)(14) AND, AS SUCH, IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL TAXATION OF INCOME DERIVED FROM THE PERFORMANCE OF ACTIVITIES THAT ARE IN FURTHERANCE OF ITS EXEMPT PURPOSES. HOWEVER, IRC SECTION 511 IMPOSES A TAX ON THE UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME (AS DEFINED IN SECTION 512) DERIVED BY STATE-CHARTERED CREDIT UNIONS. EXEMPTION FROM CALIFORNIA INCOME TAX IS SIMILAR. FASB ASC 740-10-65, INCOME TAXES, PROVIDES GUIDANCE FOR HOW UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS SHOULD BE RECOGNIZED, MEASURED, DISCLOSED AND PRESENTED IN THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THIS REQUIRES THE EVALUATION OF TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN IN THE COURSE OF PREPARING THE CREDIT UNION'S TAX RETURNS TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE TAX POSITIONS ARE "MORE LIKELY THAN NOT" OF BEING SUSTAINED "WHEN CHALLENGED OR "WHEN EXAMINED" BY THE APPLICABLE TAX AUTHORITY. TAX POSITIONS DEEMED TO NOT MEET THE MORE-LIKELY-THAN-NOT THRESHOLD SHOULD BE RECORDED AS A TAX EXPENSE AND LIABILITY IN THE CURRENT YEAR. FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023, MANAGEMENT HAS DETERMINED THAT BLUPEAK HAS NO MATERIAL UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS, AND ACCORDINGLY, BLUPEAK HAS NOT RECORDED A LIABILITY FOR THE PAYMENT OF INTEREST OR PENALTIES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION'S CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER PRIOR TO FILING WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION (BLUPEAK) REQUIRES THAT ALL ELECTED OFFICIALS, COMMITTEE MEMBERS, MANAGEMENT, AND STAFF OF BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION AND ITS SUBSIDIARIES DISCLOSE ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. HUMAN RESOURCES AND RISK MANAGEMENT PERSONNEL MONITOR AND ENFORCE COMPLIANCE WITH BLUPEAK'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY. IN THE EVENT AN ACTUAL CONFLICT IS IDENTIFIED, RISK MANAGEMENT PERSONNEL IN PARTNERSHIP WITH HUMAN RESOURCES DETERMINE THE APPROPRIATE ACTIONS NECESSARY TO MITIGATE SUCH CONFLICTS. SUCH ACTIONS INCLUDE RESTRICTION OR EXCLUSION FROM VOTING OR PARTICIPATING IN GOVERNING DELIBERATIONS AND DECISION MAKING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION (BLUPEAK) UTILIZES COMPEASE, A SOFTWARE APPLICATION LINKED TO SALARY SURVEY DATA, TO ESTABLISH COMPENSATION LEVELS FOR EACH CREDIT UNION POSITION. COMPENSATION FOR EXECUTIVES, OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES IS BASED UPON COMPEASE EVALUATIONS, OTHER INDUSTRY COMPENSATION DATA, A CANDIDATE'S SALARY HISTORY, AND THE SALARY DEEMED NECESSARY TO ATTRACT QUALIFIED CANDIDATES BASED UPON THEIR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE. THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S COMPENSATION IS REVIEWED AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS WITH SUBSTANTIATION OF THIS PROCESS MAINTAINED IN BLUPEAK'S RECORDS. THIS PROCESS LAST OCCURRED IN JUNE 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BLUPEAK CREDIT UNION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST IN THE SAME TIME AND MANNER AS OTHER DISCLOSURES REQUIRED UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 6104.
THE OVERSIGHT AND SELECTION PROCESS HAS NOT CHANGED FROM THE PRIOR TAX YEAR.
